description: Cross-market discovery screener returning top gainers, top losers, volume leaders (with optional GICS sector and min_market_cap filters for equities) and highest implied-volatility option underlyings. Use to discover candidate tickers across the market; to inspect a specific symbol's option chain, expirations and Greeks, use get_options_chain.

asset_class.description: Instrument universe: eq (equities, default), etf or fx

metric.description: Screen: all (default: gainers, volume leaders and high implied volatility), gainers, losers, volume or high_iv

min_market_cap.description: Optional minimum market cap in USD for equities (e.g. 500000000000 or 500 for $500B; values under 1000000 are treated as billions)

sector.description: Optional GICS sector filter for equities (e.g. Technology, Healthcare, Financial Services, Consumer Cyclical, Consumer Defensive, Industrials, Energy, Basic Materials, Communication Services, Utilities, Real Estate)

name: screen_market
